description: Full 200-sample evaluation with G1-G5 guardrails on expanded dataset (150 baseline + 50 hardened perturbations)

predecessor_run.note: Historical reference run on 150 baseline samples only

guardrails.g1: validate_output_with_context() with diff_lines range check and evidence consistency
guardrails.g2: Route to REVIEW when reasoning relies on untrusted PR metadata without diff evidence (G2 get_detailed_validation consistency fix applied)
guardrails.g3: Prompt-based redaction instruction, audit-only leak detection (no REVIEW routing)
guardrails.g4: LOW confidence routes to REVIEW (MEDIUM/HIGH pass through)
guardrails.g5: Schema validation with reasoning length check (<10 chars) and location type validation

dataset.note: Superset of v100 150-sample dataset plus 50 hardened perturbation samples from Perturbation Engine v2
